title: Release train weekly prep notes - Priya Kapoor - 2026-05-22
content:
Meeting: Release Train Weekly Prep (Fri 2026-05-22)
Owner: Priya Kapoor
Attendees (planned): Noah, Jordan, Ethan, Maya, SRE on-call (TBD), Product PM (Avery)
Location: Zoom / #release-train channel
Goal: Finalize go/no-go checklist for next week’s launch window; surface remaining blockers and owners; confirm rollback and monitoring plan.

Top-line notes / context:
- Target launch window: Tue 2026-05-26 09:00 PT (canary) -> full rollout by 12:00 PT if metrics look good.
- This is the first public rollout of the optimized quantized model + new batching config. Primary goals: validate latency, verify quality/regression tests, cost baseline.
- Previous load test (2026-05-20): 95th latency = 210ms steady-state at 2k rps with batching; memory pressure observed on 4/8 nodes during long sequences. SRE investigating.

Agenda items:
1) Quick status roundup (each owner, 3 min)
   - infra / SRE: canary cluster readiness, node images, config pinning
   - serving runtime: KV cache migration, quantization flags, model variant tagging
   - product/QA: regression evals, user-facing behavior tests, API contract verification
   - analytics/observability: dashboards, alerts, tracing hooks, cost dashboard
   - docs / runbook: on-call playbook + rollback steps, customer comms draft

2) Go/No-go checklist review (walk through each item and confirm owner + state)
   - Canary cluster provisioned and smoke-tested -> owner: Jordan -> STATUS: in_progress (smoke tests green, autoscaler tuning pending)
   - Node image with runtime v3.4 deployed to canary -> owner: Noah -> STATUS: done
   - Model artifact validated (checksum + tags) -> owner: Maya -> STATUS: done
   - Quantized model regression within tolerance on eval set -> owner: Priya -> STATUS: in_review (two failing prompts, see notes)
   - KV cache migration dry-run completed -> owner: Ethan -> STATUS: blocked (migration script times out on large prefixes)
   - Monitoring & alerts configured (latency cost QPS) -> owner: SRE -> STATUS: in_progress
   - Rollback tested and documented -> owner: Jordan -> STATUS: in_progress (partial)
   - Customer comms + support playbook ready -> owner: Avery -> STATUS: in_review

3) Blockers / Risks (priority order)
   - KV cache migration timeout on long prefixes (high) -> Impact: potential increased latency at scale; Risk to go-no-go if not resolved. Proposed mitigation: limit prefix size + throttled migration; owner: Ethan; ETA: 2026-05-22 EOD for mitigation patch.
   - Memory pressure on a subset of nodes during long sessions (high) -> Impact: node OOM risk during canary. SRE investigating swap/oom-kill patterns. Mitigation: revert to smaller batch cap for affected nodes; owner: Jordan; ETA: 2026-05-22 noon to validate config.
   - Two failing prompts in regression eval (medium) -> Impact: quality regression for edge-case prompts (summarization of code blocks). Action: triage failing prompts, run alternate quantization profile; owner: Priya + Applied ML; ETA: 2026-05-22 18:00.
   - Monitoring alert thresholds not final (low-med) -> need to confirm SLO triggers and pager windows. Owner: SRE + Product; ETA: 2026-05-22 meeting follow-up.

4) Action items (owner / due)
   - Ethan: implement migration timeout workaround + run full dry-run on staging; due 2026-05-22 EOD.
   - Jordan: validate autoscaler tuning and reduced batch cap for affected nodes; due 2026-05-22 12:00.
   - Priya: finish regression triage and try quantization profile v2; document prompts and attach to PR; due 2026-05-22 18:00.
   - Noah: confirm node image rollout to canary and ensure rollout pin for dedicated customers; due 2026-05-22 15:00.
   - Avery: finalize customer comms draft and support playbook, include triage steps for quality regressions; due 2026-05-22 17:00.
   - SRE (Alex on-call): finalize alert thresholds and dashboard links in runbook; due 2026-05-22 16:00.

5) Go/No-go criteria (quick checklist we will use on Monday pre-launch)
   - Critical (must be green): canary cluster smoke tests, rollback validated, KV migration issue mitigated or blocked behind feature flag, no P0 regressions on evaluation set.
   - Important (should be green): monitoring alerts firing correctly, autoscaler behavior within expectations, customer comms ready.
   - Optional: cost baseline validated within 10% of test predictions, final documentation copy published.

Notes to self / things to raise in meeting:
- Ask SRE if we have runbook entry for partial rollback (canary -> 25% -> 0%) with traffic-splitting commands. I want explicit CLI commands and timing guidance.
- Confirm whether Dedicated customers will be auto-upgraded in this rollout window — product said no, but double-check.
- Remind applied-ml to include the QA prompt-suite with exact seed so regressions are reproducible.

Quick logs / links I pulled for meeting:
- Load test summary (2026-05-20): https://internal/reports/loadtest-2026-05-20
- Regression eval PR: github.com/redwood/model-evals/pull/321
- Migration script: github.com/redwood/inference-scripts/commit/ae12f
- Runbook draft: CONFLUENCE: release-runbook v2

Follow-up: I will run a short async check-in after the meeting and update this doc with final go/no-go state. If any critical blocker remains after Friday EOD, escalate to CTO and pause rollout.

Unresolved questions:
- Is there an SLA change when we flip to quantized models for hosted API? (Product to confirm)
- Do we need to schedule a post-launch review session (recommended) — suggest Wed 2026-05-27 10:00 PT.

-- Priya
(Notes are a bit messy — will clean up final runbook copy after owners confirm statuses)
